title: Embedding-Based Intake Relevance
objective: Replace unreliable binary LLM relevance classification during structured intake.
hypothesis: The local embedding model provides a more consistent relevance signal than the local 3B LLM for short intake answers.

baseline.description: llama3.2:3b binary YES/NO classification after semantic similarity measurement.

intervention.description: nomic-embed-text cosine similarity as the deterministic intake relevance gate.

llm_classifier_result: NO for a clearly relevant personal-information answer, including after few-shot prompting.
limitation: Threshold is based on a small controlled sample and requires a larger labeled validation set for production calibration.
